title: Resisting Arrest and Eluding
grade_or_penalty: Resisting arrest: disorderly persons; 4th degree if by flight; 3rd degree if force or threat of force is used against the officer, or physical means create substantial risk of injury. Eluding: 3rd degree; 2nd degree if the flight creates a risk of death or injury
key_points: Resisting: purposely preventing or trying to prevent an officer from making an arrest; unlawfulness of the arrest is not a defense if the officer was acting under color of authority.
Eluding: knowingly fleeing or attempting to elude an officer after a signal to stop a vehicle; the license is suspended upon conviction.
elements: Resisting: The suspect purposely prevented or tried to prevent an officer from effecting an arrest
Resisting: The suspect knew or had reason to know the person was a law enforcement officer making an arrest
Resisting upgrade: by flight (4th degree), or using or threatening force, or creating a substantial risk of injury (3rd degree)
Eluding: The suspect operated a motor vehicle on a street or highway
Eluding: After receiving any signal from an officer to bring the vehicle to a full stop, the suspect knowingly fled or tried to elude
Eluding upgrade: the flight created a risk of death or injury to any person (2nd degree)
